description: Statutory cantonal minimum wages in Switzerland (official cantonal pages): hourly amount, valid from, history and the monthly equivalent at 40 hours. Only five cantons have one (BS, GE, JU, NE, TI); without canton the list of all five is returned. Elsewhere minimums apply only through collective or standard employment contracts.

canton.description: Canton as 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. "ZH", "GE", "TI". Only BS, GE, JU, NE and TI have one; omit for all five.
